technique_name: Build an algorithm to detect plagiarism in a text.
description: One approach to detecting plagiarism in texts is to compare two documents and measure their similarity. This can be done by comparing the content of the documents, such as their structure and language, or by comparing the content of their graphical representations such as fingerprints. Text-based methods involve algorithms that compare sentences or sections of text to determine the degree of similarity between the two documents being compared.
